add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

spec2def(mciwave.dll mciwave.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# mciwave.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mciwave-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(mciwave_shims OBJECT mciwave.c)
target_link_libraries(mciwave_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libuser32 libwinmm libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(mciwave_shims)
target_compile_options(mciwave_shims PRIVATE "-Wno-overflow")
add_cargo_module(mciwave mciwave-cargo mciwave.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mciwave_shims psdk)
